full_name: Dorothy Wong | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Focusing on the study of Chinese Buddhist art of the medieval period (fourth to tenth century), Dorothy Wong’s research addresses the broader issues of art in relation to religion and society.
